## Activity

During November 2020, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 29 captures. This reflects the activity submitted for review during the month. The site should continue to maintain routine capture activity and ensure that any operational issues affecting submissions are recorded and followed up through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Image quality

Image quality was acceptable for all submitted captures. Graders marked 0 captures as ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 0.0. No captures were therefore excluded from grading on image-quality grounds. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that results were generally available promptly for review. The site should continue to monitor grading outcomes and ensure that referable results are managed through the established clinical follow-up process.
